name: Aster Loy
life: Aster can calculate a slope in her head and can't make herself throw out an old calendar. This combination was harmless until a tide line involved children who had worked all morning. On Monday, near Tideline Market, Aster picks out the bruised fruit first and asks the seller what will ripen by supper.
voice: I painted the line with a tide table from the wrong year. I told the smallest builder first. She asked for my ruler and put me to work on drainage.
appearance: Aster is easy to recognize by closely cropped salt-and-pepper hair and a wide brow and a narrow jaw. Usually dressed in an unlined tan jacket with a thin silver ring worn on a cord, Aster holds eye contact until the other person has finished when listening.
personality: Aster gets protective of anybody who comes into a meeting unprepared. Aster privately wishes people would notice the amount of preparation behind this apparent ease.
agenda: To correct the tide mark in front of the builders affected.
family: Jeff Jones is Aster’s younger cousin. Aster asks before bringing somebody along. Jeff can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *A room for a father*, Jeff says, “I paid for the train fare and secretly hoped he'd miss the train.”
connections: Cato Hull. One knows where the line should have gone. The other knows how the water reached it anyway.

reactions.situation: The water reaches a child's castle before judging
reactions.response: Aster gives the builder time to show the judges what the water took.

reactions.situation: A driver splashes a market worker and tries to laugh it off
reactions.response: Aster asks the driver to come back on foot and look at the damaged goods before discussing cost.
reactions.asWritten: A driver splashes a market worker and tries to laugh it off. Aster asks the driver to come back on foot and look at the damaged goods before discussing cost.

reactions.situation: If a colleague lies to save face
reactions.response: Aster offers one private chance to correct it before the next conversation.
